g.text: P136 — Paid work and observed intervention
All modes pay host observation/capture costs. Notice dispatch, cumulative ID rows and rows with missing fields are separate.
ID and field-row exposure is cumulative across paid actor requests, not unique entities or completed obligations.
A capture without subsequent dispatch is not exposure. All modes use the original raw initial guide and tools; queries are absent.
No public handle is displayed. Equal initial inputs do not guarantee equal trajectories across independent runs.
Host seconds overlap work/session time and are not added again. Bytes are never converted to tokens. Enumeration is not official success.
